Overview
Learn how to simplify financial and sales planning to optimize sales territories, deploy equitable and fair quotas, and maximize revenue.
Persona-based dashboards
Access the Dashboard tab for administrators to view key territory program statistics. It features widgets such as Territories, Quota Insights, and Accounts by Territory, with data updated by selected dates and filters.
Monitor and analyze sales data, track progress against targets, and make informed decisions to optimize sales operations with robust analytics and reporting.
Access key statistics on territory programs in the dashboard for sales reps and managers. Filter by territory, program, and target type, and view widgets for assigned quota, inbox tasks, attainment, opportunities, and sales insights.

Territory management and AI optimization
Easily build and keep your territories current by defining and executing rules on the most up-to-date data.
Use visual mapping, to manage territories easily. Geospatial analysis helps spot trends, gaps, and untapped markets, supporting smarter resource allocation and informed sales planning.
Optimize territory creation with AI while considering multiple constraints and objectives - including minimizing overlap between territories, maximizing sales potential, and helping ensure workload and travel efficiency.

Sales forecasting and quota planning
Analyze sales performance and patterns with multiyear historical data from enterprise solutions. Flexible calculations allow cross-referencing quota types and midcycle adjustments for changing conditions.
Set granular quota by product category, product SKU, accounts, or period with multidimensional quota calculations.
Choose from flexible options to phase quotas based on historical data, pipeline insights, or custom allocation percentages.
